policy.description: Reference policy for risk-unit-bound production configuration changes.
runtime_invariants: Every tool call uses the shared Action Passport and Action Gateway path.
A production patch is bound to tenant, service, expected version, plan and risk units.
A failed post-change health gate restores the exact pre-change configuration.
An unreconcilable upstream commit enters UNKNOWN_MANUAL and stops automatic redispatch.

approval.reason: A separate reviewer checked the frozen service, patch, version, risk units and exact scope.
